!3 Shoot the host, then ask the proxy what happened

Both time limits are turned down first, so this page finishes in seconds. Without a read timeout a
host that stops answering would hang the whole run - and !-FitNesse-! has no read timeout of its own,
so the proxy is the only place where that is fixable.

!|script|!-SlimProxy.Core-!|
|set connect timeout|2000  |
|set read timeout   |4000  |
|$pid=  |target process id|Sim|

!|script|!-SlimProxy.Host-!|
|$killed=|kill host|$pid   |
|reject  |is host running  |$pid|

!3 The proxy answers with a diagnosis instead of hanging

''!-Ping Target-!'' does a real round trip and hands the cause back instead of raising it, so this
page can assert it. A forwarded fixture call in its place would end as a red page carrying the very
same message - which is exactly what turns a hang into a diagnosable result.

!|script   |!-SlimProxy.Core-!|
|show      |ping target|Sim   |
|check not |ping target|Sim   |OK|
|check     |target status     |=~/BROKEN since/|
